answer.worked:
Ordered data: $11,\ \underline{24,\ 28},\ 36$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Median}&=\frac{24+28}{2}\\\text{Median}&=\frac{52}{2}\\\text{Median}&=26\end{align*}$$
